render_meta.camera_convention: OpenCV optical frame: x right, y down, z forward; T_world_cv = T_world_mjcam @ diag(1,-1,-1,1)
render_meta.depth_convention: z-depth along the optical axis in metres = png * depth_scale_m; 0 where no geometry

trajectory.description: base-frame offsets and rotations about base axes on top of the reset pose

configuration.fp_pose: T_camera_mesh = center_pose @ to_origin (FP's raw return, original mesh frame)
configuration.registration: frame 0 only, simulator mask; all later frames tracker.track, no reset, no GT
configuration.symmetry_definition: S_k = inv(to_origin) @ Rot180_k @ to_origin, k in {identity, OBB x, y, z}
